newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gerling - Eurotunnel blaze cost it 120 mln dmk.
newsitem.headline: Gerling - Eurotunnel blaze cost it 120 mln dmk.

text.p: German industrial insurer Gerling Konzern Versicherungs Beteiligungs AG said the freight train fire last November in the Channel Tunnel which injured 34 people would cost it around 120 million marks.
Gerling chairman Juergen Zech told a news conference late on Wednesday that the German group was one of Tunnel operator Eurotunnel Plc /SA's main insurers.
Zech estimated the total cost of the blaze, which closed the Channel Tunnel link for two weeks after causing serious damage to a section of the undersea passage, at just under one billion marks.
Among the other major claims it faces this year, Gerling said it expected a charge of around 50 million marks from a fire last April at the Duesseldorf airport.
While Gerling had not directly insured the airport, the charge for airline Deutsche Lufthsana's loss of business alone was more than 40 million marks.
